## YT-Chatterino 2.5.12

- Find similar live channels with common letter and number substitutions, including O/0, I or L/1, E/3, A/4 and S/5, as well as a trailing underscore. Suggestions still require your selection.
- Check for similar live channels when reconnecting a channel from its menu or reconnecting the current chat with Ctrl+F5.
- Highlight Twitch messages sent with channel points, with a separate toggle in Highlights settings. Other alerts remain independently configurable.
- Fix Enter in popup and overlay chats opening the emote picker after sending.
- Reconnect YouTube chats to the selected broadcast, and reject stale or mismatched YouTube broadcast responses.

The browser extension is unchanged; Firefox continues using the signed 2.5.8 extension.
